index.text: PostgreSQL is an advanced open-source object-relational database management system with ACID transactions.
Redis is an in-memory key-value data structure store used as a database, cache, and message broker.
SQLite is a C-language library that implements a small, fast, self-contained, high-reliability SQL database engine.
Photosynthesis is the biological process used by plants to convert light energy into chemical energy.
Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the biochemical reactions of eukaryotic cells.
General relativity is Einstein's geometric theory of gravitation explaining spacetime curvature.
Quantum entanglement occurs when a group of particles interact such that quantum state of each particle cannot be described independently.
Cryptographic hash functions like SHA-256 produce deterministic fixed-size digests resistant to collision attacks.
Role-based access control restricts system access based on authorization roles assigned to users or agents.
Project Alpha is a reality-grounded cognitive system that models causal relations and enforces constitutional governance.
